name: @activepieces/piece-linear
description: Issue tracking for modern software teams

auth.description:
To obtain your API key, follow these steps:

1. Go to settings by clicking your profile-pic (top-left)
2. Go to Security & Access section
3. On Personal API keys, give label and press create key.

linear_create_issue.name: linear_create_issue
linear_create_issue.description: Create a new issue in Linear workspace

team_id.description: The team for which the issue, project or comment will be created

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new issue in a Linear team, with optional assignee, status, labels, priority, and template. Use to file a task, bug, or work item. Requires a team ID and title; not idempotent, each call creates a distinct issue.

linear_update_issue.name: linear_update_issue
linear_update_issue.description: Update a issue in Linear Workspace

team_id.description: The team for which the issue, project or comment will be created

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing Linear issue identified by its issue ID, changing fields such as title, description, assignee, status, labels, or priority. Use to modify an issue already created. Only the provided fields are changed; repeating the same update is idempotent.

linear_create_project.name: linear_create_project
linear_create_project.description: Create a new project in Linear workspace

team_id.description: The team for which the issue, project or comment will be created

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new project under a Linear team, with optional description, icon, color, start/target dates, and status. Use to set up a new project to group issues. Requires a team ID and project name; not idempotent, each call creates a distinct project.

linear_update_project.name: linear_update_project
linear_update_project.description: Update a existing project in Linear workspace

team_id.description: The team for which the issue, project or comment will be created

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing Linear project identified by its project ID, changing fields such as name, description, icon, color, start/target dates, or status. Use to modify a project already created. Repeating the same update is idempotent.

linear_create_comment.name: linear_create_comment
linear_create_comment.description: Create a new comment on an issue in Linear workspace

team_id.description: The team for which the issue, project or comment will be created

aiMetadata.description: Posts a new comment on a Linear issue identified by its issue ID. Use to add a note, reply, or status update to an existing issue. Requires the issue ID and comment body; not idempotent, each call appends a new comment.

Sends an arbitrary GraphQL query or mutation directly to the Linear API with optional variables. Use as an escape hatch when no dedicated action covers the needed operation. Idempotency depends entirely on the supplied query; a read query is safe to repeat, a mutation is not.

new_comment.name: new_comment
new_comment.description: Triggers when a new comment is created on a Linear issue

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new comment is posted on a Linear issue, optionally filtered to specific teams or comment authors. Represents the created comment and its parent issue.

new_issue.name: new_issue
new_issue.description: Triggers when Linear receives a new issue

team_id.description: The team for which the issue, project or comment will be created

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new issue is created in the selected Linear team. Represents the newly created issue with its details such as title, assignee, state, and labels.

updated_issue.name: updated_issue
updated_issue.description: Triggers when an existing Linear issue is updated

team_id.description: The team for which the issue, project or comment will be created

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an existing Linear issue is modified, optionally scoped to a specific team. Represents the updated issue along with the fields that changed.

removed_issue.name: removed_issue
removed_issue.description: Triggers when an existing Linear issue is removed

team_id.description: The team for which the issue, project or comment will be created

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an existing issue is deleted from the selected Linear team. Represents the issue as it was at the time of removal.

new_project.name: new_project
new_project.description: Triggers when a new project is created in Linear

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new project is created anywhere in the Linear workspace. Represents the newly created project with its details such as name, state, dates, and teams.

updated_project.name: updated_project
updated_project.description: Triggers when the status of an Linear project is updated

project_status.description: Filter by project status (leave empty to include all)

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a Linear project status changes, optionally filtered to specific teams or a target status. Represents the project after the status change.

removed_project.name: removed_project
removed_project.description: Triggers when an existing Linear project is removed

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an existing project is deleted anywhere in the Linear workspace. Represents the project as it was at the time of removal.
